title: Harry Potter season fondue (red Meltie mug, bedside) — restage 02
notes: Restage 02 of shorts/uMl76XX7epo: RED variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), the treats on the walnut bedside table (a walnut bedside table next to a bed at night, a tall grey upholstered headboard with linen pillows and a knitted throw beside it, a brass bedside lamp with a pleated shade glowing) instead of the white desk in front of red curtains. Table decor kept (pumpkins, gnome pumpkin, candle jar, laptop). Reworded hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose (brief). Laptop: generated fantasy stills; plain unbranded red bag; Sora audio.

shots.prompt: One continuous static take, no camera move. 0-0.8 s: the fork lifts the strawberry up from the board and moves it over the brim-full mug. 0.8-1.8 s: it pushes the strawberry straight DOWN INTO the mug until it disappears under the melted chocolate; the chocolate surges up and OVERFLOWS: a big wave of glossy melted chocolate spills over the rim on all sides and pours down the SIDES of the red outside of the mug in thick streams. 1.8-2.3 s: the strawberry stays under while thick chocolate keeps pouring down the outside of the mug and pools in a puddle on the walnut bedside table around its base. 2.3-3.5 s: it rises slowly straight back up out of the mug, fully coated in glossy chocolate, dripping, while the overflow keeps running down the mug into the growing puddle. 3.5-4 s: held still just above the mug. The strawberry stays on the fork the whole time. Lots of spilled chocolate, yet the mug's shape, its handle and the 'Chocolate...' lettering on its front stay clearly visible: the streams run down the sides and the back, not over the front.
